claims.text: Tolvaptan, a vasopressin receptor 2 antagonist, may benefit pts w ADPKD.
claims.quote: Tolvaptan, a vasopressin receptor 2 antagonist, is a medication that may benefit patients with ADPKD (1, 2).
claims.locator: Treatment of ADPKD › Vasopressin antagonism or suppression

claims.text: Appears to slow increase in renal volume and decline in renal function.
claims.quote: Tolvaptan appears to slow increase in renal volume and decline in renal function, but it can cause adverse effects due to free water diuresis (eg, thirst, polydipsia, polyuria) that can make adherence difficult.
claims.locator: Treatment of ADPKD › Vasopressin antagonism or suppression

claims.text: May especially benefit pts at higher risk for rapid progression of kidney dz.
claims.quote: Tolvaptan may be especially beneficial for patients at higher risk for rapid progression of kidney disease.
claims.locator: Treatment of ADPKD › Vasopressin antagonism or suppression

claims.text: ADRs from free water diuresis (thirst, polydipsia, polyuria) can make adherence difficult.
claims.quote: Tolvaptan appears to slow increase in renal volume and decline in renal function, but it can cause adverse effects due to free water diuresis (eg, thirst, polydipsia, polyuria) that can make adherence difficult.
claims.locator: Treatment of ADPKD › Vasopressin antagonism or suppression

claims.text: Has caused severe liver failure: CI w significant liver impairment or injury.
claims.quote: Tolvaptan has been reported to cause severe liver failure and is hence contraindicated in patients with significant liver impairment or injury.
claims.locator: Treatment of ADPKD › Vasopressin antagonism or suppression

claims.text: Expert consultation recommended before starting; not recommended < 18 years.
claims.quote: Expert consultation is recommended before starting tolvaptan due to its potential adverse effects. Tolvaptan has not been studied in children and is not recommended in those < 18 years of age.
claims.locator: Treatment of ADPKD › Vasopressin antagonism or suppression
